svg.text: The Big Picture — the library sorted by MEANING · the hall is in the repo
💡 PART 1 — THE IDEA (lessons 1–4)
🗺️ meaning as seats
keywords match STRINGS — 'kind to animals'
misses 'Every Living Thing' · seat texts in
meaning-space and search becomes geometry
🔢 text → vector
toy: hashed word counts (nearsighted —
'pupils' ≠ 'students'!) · real: learned
embeddings, fixed-size (hundreds–thousands of) meaning-dims · same DB
📐 similarity = direction
cosine compares which way vectors POINT —
essay and note about robots are siblings ·
normalize at write → one-line dot at read ⚡
🏃 neighbors at scale
brute force: correct, dies at millions ·
HNSW friendship-map hops / IVF districts —
approximate, with a recall dial 🎯
🔬 the repo: vectordb/vectordb.py — ~70 lines, zero dependencies
embed() hash → normalize · cosine() one-line dot · MiniVectorDB: add / filtered search / top-k
the embedder is ONE swappable function — the industry's architecture, in miniature
😬 the honest failure, on purpose
demo.py queries 'pupils' → 0.00 scores: word-vectors can't see synonyms —
the best argument for learned embeddings you'll ever RUN (swap embed(), it just works)
python3 vectordb/demo.py — index, search, filter, and one beautiful failure, in 60 seconds
🔧 PART 2 — FOR REAL (lessons 5–8)
✂️🏷️ scissors & stickers (lesson 06)
chunk on natural seams · self-contained cards ·
overlap 🔁 (fit the docs) · stickers: room/kind/source →
filtered search + citations 🧾 · hybrid = meaning
+ keywords merged (E-4012 needs exact match!)
chunking moves quality a lot · the index mostly moves speed
📖 RAG, end to end (lesson 07)
index time: docs → chunk → embed → store (re-index
tonight, 'knows' it tomorrow) · question time: embed
the question (SAME model!) → nearest cards → desk:
'answer ONLY from these, cite ids' → receipts 🧾
debugging drill: bad answer? print the CARDS first
🏬 the landscape (lesson 08)
🐘 pgvector — the library you already have ·
☁️ managed (rent) · 🧪 Chroma/Qdrant (lab bench) ·
⚙️ FAISS (engine block) · 🔎 old store, new tricks ·
ask: filtered ANN? hybrid? deletes? the
re-embedding day ⚠️ recall numbers attached?
🧭 the boring pick order: pgvector → embedded lab bench → managed/self-hosted at real scale · under ~100k vectors, a loop is fine 😄
siblings: AI school (embeddings L04, RAG L10 — this is their machine room) · Agents school (this is their memory) ·
and the ops schools for when you self-host the hall ☸️ — the embedder boundary keeps your vectors portable either way
